fenris_keep_scout: Scout Merrin. Keep behind the hedge. That is Baron Ashbury's manor behind the gate, at the north end of the isle, and I watch it from here. The guards have not been relieved since the curse. Neither has the Baron.
fenris_altar_warden: Orlan, warden. This is the west ridge of Fenris, and the arch behind me goes down to the Shadowpine Altar, where the curse was cast. I keep watch so that nothing climbs back up. Ten years. Nothing has, that I have seen.
fenris_grave_hunter: Selke, gravehunter. East of here is Cur's Grave, the whole east shore - a kennel for ghosts. The dogs I can handle. It is the keeper I do not like the sound of, and I have only ever had the sound.
fenris_village_elder: Corwell. I was the Baron's huntsman, and I live in Bloodmoon now with everyone else who is left. Ashbury ruled this isle alive and he rules it worse dead. Someone needs to finish what the curse started. His manor is north, at the end of the spine road.
bloodmoon_elder: Gravemoss, elder of Bloodmoon Village. You are in it - the south of the isle, just up from the pier. This is the only safe ground left on Fenris, and even that is generous. The docks are west of us and I would not go down to them alone.
fenris_pier_warden: Hask, pier-warden. This is the south pier of Fenris Isle, and the boat behind you is the only way off. The ferry leaves when the lake lets it. If you are staying, stay off the water. It remembers the crossing.
